topic: Total earnings from mowing lawns at a flat rate per lawn
core_question: A landscaper charges $40 per lawn and mows 7 lawns in a weekend. Find the total earnings. (secondary: A delivery truck travels at 85 mph for 3 hours. How many miles does it cover?)
answer_summary: the total of $280 (7 lawns mowed at $40 each); after the topic shift: 255 miles (85 mph for 3 hours)
